searchText: I think technically speaking “proof of history” is not Solana’s consensus mechanism. It is a centralized proof of stake chain — proof of history (to simplify things) is a timestamping mechanism similar to what cell towers do in order to reduce unnecessary costs associated with messaging Also this is an excellent resource <@393119312350543872>!

excerpts.content: I think technically speaking “proof of history” is not Solana’s consensus mechanism. It is a centralized proof of stake chain — proof of history (to simplify things) is a timestamping mechanism similar to what cell towers do in order to reduce unnecessary costs associated with messaging
